entities.name: Sir Odric
entities.description: A master tactician on Innistrad, Church commander and Lunarch Marshal, later turned into a vampire by Henrika Domnathi.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: The church Odric served as commander.

entities.name: Ludevic's Abomination
entities.description: Creature of the mad scientist Ludevic that Odric chased.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: Odric's lieutenant who begged for Garruk's life.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: Cursed, weakened planeswalker captured by Odric.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City where the Church would decide Garruk's fate.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: Council of senior bishops formed to deal with Avacyn's madness; later exposed as controlled by the Skirsdag.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: Cult that controlled the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Leader Odric joined as part of the Order of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Group Odric and Grete joined after fleeing the Church.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: Demon whose return to the material plane Henrika's ritual sought.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who made a pact with the humans.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel in whose name Grete begged for Garruk's life.

events.summary: Odric is tasked with chasing and capturing Ludevic's Abomination.
events.quote: One of his duties as a Church commander was chasing and capturing the mad scientist Ludevic 's Abomination

events.summary: Odric and Grete capture the cursed Garruk, and Odric drugs him and takes him to Thraben.
events.quote: Odric then drugged the planeswalker, tied him up, and moved him to Thraben

events.summary: As Marshal, Odric organizes the Lunarch Council and earns a nonvoting seat.
events.quote: Odric showed tremendous initiative in organizing the Lunarch Council to deal with Avacyn's madness.

events.summary: After the Council is exposed as Skirsdag-controlled, Odric and Grete flee the Church and join Thalia's Order of Saint Traft.
events.quote: Odric and Grete fled the Church and joined Thalia as part of the Order of Saint Traft .

events.summary: Odric throws himself before a blade meant for Thalia, saving her but dooming himself, and is bitten by Henrika.
events.quote: he interrupted the ritual by throwing himself before a blade meant for his ally, saving her but dooming himself.

events.summary: Odric, now a vampire, finds the moon brings him peace and his faith restored.
events.quote: Ironically, his transformation had restored his shaken faith.

relations.quote: he was turned into a vampire by Henrika Domnathi .
